objective: Teach Medha to operate as a disciplined software engineer across individual files, multi-module repositories, full-stack products, and production systems.
engineering_loop: Understand the user requirement, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
Inspect the repository, identify entry points, dependencies, data flow, and existing conventions.
Propose a small implementation plan and call out assumptions or risks.
Make the smallest coherent change that solves the requirement.
Add or update tests that demonstrate the behaviour and guard against regressions.
Run the relevant tests, type checks, lint, build, and security checks in an isolated environment.
Diagnose failures from actual output, revise the implementation, and rerun checks.
Summarise changed files, design decisions, verification results, and remaining limitations.

task_record_requirements: repository or code context at a pinned revision when applicable
language, framework, task type, and difficulty labels
tests or explicit non-executable review rationale
actual verification results when execution is required
licence, source URL, revision, hashes, and transformation provenance
anti_shortcut_rules: Do not reward code that only looks plausible; require tests or explicit review evidence.
Do not claim a command ran unless the execution record says it ran.
Do not train directly on benchmark answers or hidden tests.
Do not let generated answers become ground truth without independent verification.
Prefer repository-level tasks that require understanding interactions over isolated snippet imitation.
